## COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES

Thursday, November 12th, 2026
12:00 pm
**Beverly Council on Aging, 90 Colon St**

Paul Willenbrock, Nevaeh Hourican, Ameila Boivin, James Butler, Ed Horack, Marilyn Hourican-Osburn, Bud Rehal

## Statement of Purpose

We champion the full inclusion of people with disabilities in every facet of community life. In partnership with the Massachusetts Office on Disability (MOD), Massachusetts Commission for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing (MCDHH). We advance equity, accessibility, and a true sense of belonging ensuring Beverly is a place where everyone can participate, contribute, and thrive.

## 1. Welcome Back & Access Check-In (12:00 – 12:05 PM)

- Welcome from Acting Chair Ameila Boivin
- Confirm access supports:
  - ASL interpretation available from MCDHH
  - CART captioning available via meeting live stream.
  - Accessible materials displayed on screen, with a large-print agenda
  - Braille available upon request
  - Meeting livestreamed and recorded by BevCam
- Brief access pause

## 2. Roll Call & Minutes Approval (12:05 – 12:10 PM)

- Roll call of Commission members
- Approval of minutes from the October 22, 2026 meeting

## 3. Public Discussion (12:10 – 12:30 PM)

- Members of the public are invited to share comments or concerns with the Commission
- Comments are limited to 5 minutes per speaker

## 4. Election of Officers (12:30 – 12:40 PM)

- Discuss how the Commission will elect its officers
  - Who is eligible to vote and to serve
  - Nomination process and term length
  - How votes will be casted
- Vote to set the election date: **January 28th, 2027**

## 5. Winter Goals Discussion (12:40 – 12:50 PM)

- Discuss goals for winter accessibility
  - Snow and ice clearing at accessible parking, curb cuts and sidewalks
  - Bus stops and winter transportation through the Council on Aging
- Identify two or three goals to pursue

## 7. Next Steps & Adjournment (12:50 – 1:00 PM)

- Confirm next meeting date: **December 10th**
- Recap the change of planning to meet in January and February
- Adjourn

### Additional Information

- The Friends of Beverly Recreation fund is now able to accept donations for the Commission's use. Checks can be made out to "Friends of Beverly Recreation Inc" with a note that it's for the Commission on Disabilities. Checks can be mailed to P.O. Box 691 Beverly, MA 01915.
